description: This file contains CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) functions for managing users, food logs, nutritional goals, and statistics in a calorie tracking backend. It interacts with SQLAlchemy ORM models and schemas, providing API functions for data manipulation and retrieval.

methods.name: models.User create_user(db: Session, user_in: schemas.UserCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new user with a hashed password and saves it to the database.

methods.name: models.FoodLog create_food_log(db: Session, user_id: int, log_in: schemas.FoodLogCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new food log entry for a user and saves it to the database.

methods.name: List[models.FoodLog] get_food_logs(db: Session, user_id: int, date_filter: date = None, limit: int = 100)
methods.description: Retrieves food logs for a user, optionally filtered by date, with a limit.

methods.name: bool delete_food_log(db: Session, user_id: int, food_log_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a specified food log entry if it exists.

methods.name: models.Goal upsert_goal(db: Session, user_id: int, goal_in: schemas.GoalCreate)
methods.description: Sets or updates the nutrition goal for a specific date for a user.

methods.name: List[models.Goal] get_goals(db: Session, user_id: int, limit=30)
methods.description: Retrieves recent nutrition goals for a user.

methods.name: List[schemas.NutritionStats] get_nutrition_stats(db: Session, user_id: int, start_date: date, end_date: date)
methods.description: Calculates aggregated nutrition statistics over date range.
